The labs are a single project assembled over three weeks: each day reuses the previous
day's code, ending in a transformer language model you build yourself.

Each lab is a guided walkthrough with `# TODO` cells for you to fill in, and worked
solutions at the very bottom. Don't scroll to the solutions until you've had a real go —
the point is the struggle, not the finished cell.

**To run a lab:** click **Open in Colab** (recommended — free GPU for the later labs), or
**view** the read-only page here, or download the **.ipynb**. The first cell of every lab
sets things up; just run top to bottom.

## The capstone {#capstone}

Lab 11 ends with the payoff of the whole course: **Andrej Karpathy's
[pure-Python microGPT](https://gist.github.com/karpathy/8627fe009c40f57531cb18360106ce95)**,
a complete GPT in ~200 lines with no PyTorch — running entirely on the `Value` autograd
class you wrote back in Labs 3–4. The lab maps every part of the gist back to the lab where
you first built it.
